reviews.text: Very chill professor who is happy to help those interested in Law despite being a busy attorney. The class seems intimidating at first with all the legal jargon and cases to remember, but there are only 3 written assignments and 2 presentations the entire semester. The class is a bit disorganized, but you can usually find everything you need under the modules tab on Canvas. Coming from a STEM background, I felt that it was not very hard to complete and do well on the assignments.

ASAMST W20AC.sentiment: Students describe a manageable, mostly online class with recorded lectures, weekly quizzes with multiple attempts and a group podcast project. Readings are extensive and quizzes and exams can ask for small details. Lectures are seen as interesting but monotone, and GSIs matter.
